name: Witch Doctor Voodoo Unleashed cuts the Shadow Puppets cooldown by 3 sec
contract: Voodoo Unleashed 705901: 'casting Bad Juju now reduces the cooldown of Shadow Puppets by $/1000;504607S1 sec.'
504607 Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_COOLDOWN 165 on misc 500015 with BasePoints -3001 + 1 = -3000, so
the tooltip reads 3 sec. AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:367-368 cut Shadow Puppets by a hard-coded 5000 ms
on every Juju cast with 705901 known (cycle 9 sweep 20261121-051237: the cost_gate attempt 3500 ms before the
uncut end at 14500 ms went through). The fix reads the cut from 504607. Shadow Puppets 500015: instant, GCD
1500, RecoveryTime 18000, 15% base mana. Bad Juju 802087: CastingTimeIndex 19 = 2500 ms, 16% base mana,
CategoryRecoveryTime 15000, cast 2000 ms after the Puppets, so its cast completes about 4500 ms in. Both
players cast Puppets and then Bad Juju at the dummy at the same moments; only the doctor knows 705901 (the
plain player is the control). At 5000 ms after the Puppets cast the plain player's Puppets cooldown reads
18000 - 5000 = 13000 ms (judged 12700 to 13300) and the doctor's reads 10000 ms (9700 to 10300), which
excludes the 5000 ms cut (8000) and no cut (13000). The doctor's Puppets is then refused at 14000 ms (1000 ms
of cooldown left, more than the 400 ms spell queue; refused only if the cut is under 4 sec) and accepted at
15500 ms, while the plain player's is refused at 15500 ms (2500 ms left).
